title: ProsecutionBench prosecution state S_t (week-3 pilot, v1)
description: State of one application at one cutoff. stage O1_cutoff = record through the O1 mail date; A1_cutoff = record through the A1 filing date (actual A1 included). Every claim and rejection points to its source document and passage.

entered_claims.description: Claim set of record (what the examiner examines). At O1_cutoff: the claims examined in O1. At A1_cutoff: the same set unless an A1 amendment is entered (see entry_status rules).

proposed_claims.description: Claims as listed in a reply that is not (yet) known to be entered. Empty at O1_cutoff. At A1_cutoff: the A1 claim listing (empty when A1 has no claim listing, e.g. argument-only reply).

span.description: short verbatim quote (<= 30 words) or paragraph/page locator from the source text

claim_id.description: claim number as filed; canceled numbers are never reused

version_id.description: doc_id of the document that introduced this text version ('as_filed' for the application as filed / PGPUB)

text.description: clean claim text of this version (inserted text kept, deleted text removed, no status label); empty for canceled claims

ground.description: 112 subsection from the action ('first paragraph' = 112a, 'second paragraph' = 112b); 112 when not stated; dp = double patenting; objection = claim objection (not a rejection)

references.description: cited references for 102/103/dp, as named in the action

evidence.description: where the ground is stated (the action) and, for a status other than outstanding, the record that changed it
